Comment hover-bridge test

Hover the highlighted finding below — a "💬 Comment this" pill should appear. Move the cursor onto the pill: it must remain visible throughout the trip (180 ms grace window per references/runtime-bug-patterns.md). If the pill disappears the moment the cursor leaves the anchor, the bridge is broken.

Finding 1 — hover bridge target

This paragraph is the comment anchor. Real users approach the pill by sliding the mouse off the right edge of this box, which fires mouseleave on the anchor before mouseover fires on the pill — the 180 ms timer must keep the pill alive across that ~4 px gap.

Spacer paragraph — present so the anchored finding is comfortably away from page edges, giving the absolute-positioned pill room to render without overlapping the viewport border.
